disposition_reason: Supports the statement that gallium on leafy vegetables is partly surface-bound and reduced by washing. Does not give intake estimates.

study.method: Washed and unwashed vegetable tissues were digested and analyzed by ICP-MS; lead isotope ratios were used to trace sources.
study.site_context: urban garden soil; lettuce; tomato; radish; spinach

regulatory_or_exposure: Gallium below quantification limit in tomato fruit parts
Washing significantly reduced gallium in lettuce
